# The paths that may differ from the tag tom-perry-1.15, which is OpenXTalk
# Lite 1.15 as Tom Perry left it. tools/ci/pristine_guard.py checks every
# change against this list (the "Pristine guard" workflow, on every push and
# pull request, and before every release); a path that no pattern matches
# fails it.
#
# One pattern per line, relative to the repository root; "*" matches within
# one path segment, "**" across segments; text after "#" is a comment.
#
# [harness] is this repository's own files: CI, tests, packaging and
# documentation. Nothing in them is built into the product.
#
# [build] is Tom Perry's files that the build changes touch, one by one:
# what current compilers, SDKs and systems need to build his code, and
# nothing else. Each is changed by a commit after tom-perry-1.15 that says
# why (most are ported from OXT-Beyond and name the commit there). Add a
# path here only in the commit that changes it, and only for the build;
# fixes and features belong in OXT-Beyond, not here.
